body:
Hi,

I'm new here, and I have no idea which category would be appropriate (there's no "bug report" category or the like), and I think this omission might not be intentional, thus decided to use "General":

When using the context menu, there's no file operation "Move", only "Delete" and "Copy to".

RT does have the Move command, and it is actually a core feature of file operations (I would actually need it to cull my images, as I don't want to delete images, but move them to a subfolder "_trash" or the like, or might even want to move images "out of the way" by moving them to specific subfolders).

Best, Christian
title: File operation "Move" missing in context menu
